question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with more than zero total units, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term that are letter graded, and calculate the normalized variation range (coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) multiplied by the units range, rounded to four decimal places). Present the results ordered by normalized variation range in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  STDDEV(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END) AS coefficient_of_variation,
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END)
  - MIN(CASE WHEN c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END) AS units_range,
  VARIANCE(CASE WHEN c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END) AS units_variance,
  ROUND(
    STDDEV(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END)
    * (MAX(CASE WHEN c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END)
       - MIN(CASE WHEN c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' THEN c.TOTAL_UNITS END)),
    4
  ) AS normalized_variation_range
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
ORDER BY normalized_variation_range DESC

MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH SubjectMaxUnits AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE), TermUnitStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT smu.SUBJECT_CODE, smu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, smu.SUBJECT_TITLE, smu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, smu.TERM_CODE, smu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, smu.TERM_START_DATE, smu.max_total_units_3rows, tus.TERM_PARAMETER, tus.avg_total_units, tus.total_units_variance, tus.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectMaxUnits AS smu JOIN TermUnitStats AS tus ON smu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), subq2 AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` INNER JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.LECTURE_UNITS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NULL), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l2 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18') SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN inner_cte2 AS c ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP), DepartmentSubjects AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column
